note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; the steps are generic items of the given scenario as supplied, never a requirement of any law. Times are fictional labels. "Formality provided" and "formality pending" are supplied statuses only — a pending state is not a deficiency; no formality rule, no writing, notarial or registration requirement, no consequence and no jurisdiction is stated.

presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Long names, labels, captions, references, titles, steps and time labels, three steps per document, two shared facts and a neutral note; the receipts supplied with one position (order to be examined). Capped (standing rule item 20; pre-cap values in production/scratch/contract-formation-09/LAW-0475.stress.precap.json): both party names, the step rows (labels 'Step n (as supplied in the scenario)'/'(as given)' → 'Step 1/2/3 (A)' and 'Step 1/2/3 (B)', one pattern for every row; values such as 'Copies reviewed (2)' → 'Copies reviewed: 2') and the changed fact (73 → 69 characters). True driver: the 1:1 frame's right-hand text column (comparison table + footer, where the documents' steps are printed while the stages show the documents as tokens) — pre-cap, the column needs table 508 + footer 560–618 design units against a 992-unit box at 16.1–17 px, so no stacked-column layout fits and the only fitting layout collapses the stages at the guide (people at the hold 0 px); with the cap the column fits at c = 0.38 (head box at the hold 51.9 px, text 16.1 px). Removing any one of the three capped groups brings the collapse back. Every capped field is still longer than its baseline counterpart and every count is kept (3 + 3 steps, 2 shared facts, 5 events, one shared position).
